render_render: render packed RGB and depth buffers using MuJoCo Warp render context
render_render_with_segmentation: render RGB, depth, and packed segmentation outputs with per-pixel object id and type pairs
render_require_segmentation_enabled: raise an error if the render context has no segmentation-enabled cameras configured
render_create_render_context: create a render context with segmentation rendering enabled for at least one camera
render_check_impl_warp: check that both model and data use MuJoCo Warp implementation before calling render functions
